name: update_memory
description: Update or correct an existing memory by explicit ID. Use a memory ID already visible in the current conversation or injected memory context when it clearly identifies the intended record; otherwise call search_memory or semantic_recall first. If identification is missing or ambiguous, do not update. This tool never searches or fuzzy-matches. To change a response preference's slot, scope, or expiry, call remember with the canonical preference fields instead.

memory_id.description: Exact memory ID from visible context or a prior search_memory or semantic_recall lookup.
